heading.title: Of the Produce and Interest of Legacies

article.title: Rate of interest.
article.content: The rate of interest shall be four per cent. per annum in all cases except when the testator was a Hindu, Muhammadan, Buddhist, Sikh or Jaina or an exempted person, in which case it shall be six per cent. per annum.
article.html:
353Rate of interest.

Section 353 · Part IX · Chapter XI · page 89 of the Act

The rate of interest shall be four per cent. per annum in all cases except when the testator was a Hindu, Muhammadan, Buddhist, Sikh or Jaina or an exempted person, in which case it shall be six per cent. per annum.
